notes.subject: bel bilong yu
notes.rationale: אף em i nek/nus bilong yu; Tok Pisin 'bel' i holim maneria bilong bel hebil, smok bilong paia

notes.subject: i wok long pulapul paia olsem smok
notes.rationale: יעשן אפך — bel i gat paia; literal 'ap bilong yu i smok'

notes.subject: Elohim
notes.rationale: Tok i toktok diret long Elohim, olsem kot bilong lagat

translation: Ol samting bilong skulim, bilong Asaf. Bilong wanem, Elohim, yu lusim ⟨i⟩ olgeta long taim i no gat pins; bel bilong yu i wok long pulapul paia olsem smok long ol sipsip bilong gaden bilong yu.
